title: UnitsAvailableDetails
description: Representation of many units of an Instrument are available to be traded for both long and short Orders.

long.description: The units available for long Orders.
long.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.

short.description: The units available for short Orders.
short.format: A decimal number encoded as a string. The amount of precision provided depends on what the number represents.
